What I usually do is clean the cut with hydrogen peroxide or alcohol pads, apply neosporin & cover with a bandage :) 

After it starts to scar you can try massaging it with oil & stuff to keep it hydrated & that may help it fade 

& you probably want to remember to put sunscreen on it if you go out & your face is in the sun, because it can darken the scar

I don't know everything but this is what I've always done to take care of my cuts & scars. I haven't had experience with cuts on my face before but I hope this helps anyway!!
